title: The film's call: a cloned voice asks a friend for $2,000

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hey... it's me. Sorry, I know it's late.

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: Hey man, no worries. What's going on?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I had an accident. I'm okay, but the other guy is hurt, and the police are here.

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: Wait, what? Are you okay? Where are you?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: On the highway. They're saying if I don't cover the damage tonight, they're keeping me here.

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: Okay, okay. How much do you need?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Two thousand dollars. My cards are blocked, I can't do anything from here. I'll pay you back tomorrow, I swear.

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: Don't worry about it. Send me the account, I'm doing it right now.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thank you, brother. And please, don't tell anyone yet. I don't want my mom to panic.
